Common questions

Things business owners ask us

Will a chatbot replace my team?

No. Automation handles repetitive questions and follow-ups, and passes real conversations to your team. People stay in control.

Can it work on WhatsApp?

Yes. WhatsApp and website chatbots are among the most common workflows we build.

Will it work with my CRM?

In most cases, yes. We connect to the tools you already use. We’ll confirm what’s possible in the free consultation.

What should we automate first?

Usually the task that wastes the most time or loses the most leads, often replying to new enquiries and following up.

Is my customer data safe?

Workflows run in your own accounts, and we only use the access a workflow needs.

How long does it take to set up?

Simple workflows can be ready quickly. Larger ones are built step by step. We agree a timeline before we start.

How much does AI automation cost?

It depends on the workflows and tools involved. We share a clear quote after the free consultation.
